benchmark_design.objective: Evaluate whether MLLMs can predict visible local ego-action consequences from a single egocentric RGB image by binding body footprint, action direction/horizon, and swept-volume outcome.
benchmark_design.reference_policy: Use prior spatial, affordance, capability-conditioned, and collision-grounding benchmarks only as design methodology anchors; do not copy their taxonomies or use T1/T2/T3/T4/T5 labels.

categories.title: Local Progress Estimation
categories.literature_anchor: VSI-Bench-style coarse measurement QA adapted to action-conditioned local rollout consequence.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether models estimate body-relative local progress rather than merely describing open space.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: From a valid Habitat start state, execute a forward action sequence for a specified body radius and horizon; label by actual_distance_m, intended_distance_m, progress_ratio, stopped_early, collision, height_delta_m, and hazard_type from deterministic rollout.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Prompt states body size, direction, and approximate horizon; visible local evidence supports the label; repeated rollout is stable; progress bin is margin-separated; stair/drop/support-risk cases are routed to hazard or feasibility; answer balance is enforced.

categories.title: Action-Horizon Collision
categories.literature_anchor: SpatialBench/ENACT-style action-consequence methodology narrowed to short local ego-body rollout.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether models project a concrete short action sequence into collision, stop, drop, or completion outcome.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: From the rendered start RGB, execute 1/2/3/5/10-step move_forward/turn_left/turn_right sequences with the specified body radius; label feasible only if rollout completes without collision, stopped_early, low progress, or unsafe height_delta_m.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Replayable rollout trace exists; label is stable under repeat; body size, turn angle, and horizon are stated; hidden long-range geometry cases are rejected; yes/no answer share is <=0.65.

categories.title: Directional Rollout Comparison
categories.literature_anchor: VSI-Bench configurational/relative-direction QA adapted to comparing simulated ego-action outcomes.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether models bind left/center/right action directions to actual traversable progress.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: From one start state and body radius, roll out left-turn-then-forward, straight-forward, and right-turn-then-forward candidates; label the direction with largest actual_distance_m only if the top1-top2 margin exceeds tolerance.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Three directions use matched horizons; turn angle and horizon are explicit; ties are discarded or assigned to an explicit about-same variant; no single direction exceeds the balance threshold.

categories.title: Body Counterfactual Flip
categories.literature_anchor: CapNav capability-conditioned evaluation localized to same-image body-radius swept-volume feasibility.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H3: whether changing only ground-plane body radius flips the predicted consequence and whether the model follows that flip.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: For identical RGB/start/action, roll out small and large body radii; label both-safe, small-only, or neither-safe from paired progress/collision outcomes, with small progress required no worse than large within tolerance.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Start pose is legal for all radii; real flip pairs and no-flip controls are included; traces are saved for both bodies; only-large labels are rejected; single-label share is <=0.48.

categories.title: Local Hazard Explanation
categories.literature_anchor: TouchSafeBench collision-grounding methodology adapted to visible local ego-action hazard type rather than object grounding.
categories.motivation_link: Diagnostic for H1: verifies whether failures are grounded in collision, height/drop, or support risk rather than yes/no priors.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: Execute the specified short rollout and derive hazard_type from collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, support indicators, semantic context, and trace; label collision, drop/step, insufficient support, or no obvious hazard.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Hazard is visible or locally inferable in the start RGB; semantic context is offline only; ambiguous hidden hazards and unstable first-contact regions are rejected; this category is not part of the core death-gate.

instantiation_spec.semantic_context_policy: Save depth, pose, semantics, collision feedback, height changes, rollout traces, and overlays only for offline GT/filtering/HTML. The tested model receives only the initial RGB and question. Semantic context may support filtering/display but must never override rollout outcome.
instantiation_spec.natural_question_policy: Every prompt must include body radius or width, action direction/turn angle, and approximate horizon in meters or body-widths. Use binary feasibility, coarse progress, directional ranking, body counterfactual, or short hazard answers. Ban label-leaking scene words such as clear, blocked, wider, narrower, open corridor, safe, and dangerous.

categories.template: Robot radius is about {radius_m} m, width about {body_width_m} m. Looking only at this egocentric image, if it moves straight ahead about {horizon_m} m, about {horizon_body_widths} body-widths, how much progress would it likely make? Answer: almost all / more than half / only a little / early risk or failure.
categories.gt_rule: Execute the exact forward sequence from the Habitat start pose with the selected body radius. Compute intended_distance_m, actual_distance_m, progress_ratio, collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, hazard_type, and rollout_trace_path.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: almost_all if progress_ratio>=0.85 with no collision/stopped_early and abs(height_delta_m)<0.15; more_than_half if 0.50<=progress_ratio<0.85 without hazard; only_a_little if 0.10<=progress_ratio<0.50; early_risk_or_failure if progress_ratio<0.10, collision, stopped_early, or abs(height_delta_m)>=0.20. Reject threshold-near, unstable, and stair/drop ordinary-clearance cases. Single answer share <=0.40.

categories.template: Robot radius is about {radius_m} m, width about {body_width_m} m. If it turns about {direction_deg} degrees and then moves forward about {horizon_m} m, about {horizon_body_widths} body-widths, is this short action sequence likely to complete? Answer complete or not complete, with the main failure type if not complete.
categories.gt_rule: Execute the specified 1/2/3/5/10-step action sequence using move_forward, turn_left, and turn_right. Feasibility is determined only from rollout_outcome, collision, stopped_early, progress_ratio, height_delta_m, hazard_type, and replayable trace.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: complete if progress_ratio>=0.85, collision=false, stopped_early=false, and abs(height_delta_m)<0.15. not_complete_collision if collision or contact-caused stopped_early. not_complete_height_or_support if abs(height_delta_m)>=0.20 or hazard_type marks step/drop/support risk. Reject unstable or margin-near labels. Binary answer share <=0.65.

categories.template: Robot radius is about {radius_m} m, width about {body_width_m} m. Compare three choices with the same forward horizon of about {horizon_m} m: turn left about {direction_deg} degrees then move, move straight, or turn right about {direction_deg} degrees then move. Which choice makes the most actual progress?
categories.gt_rule: From the identical start pose, body radius, and initial RGB, execute left-turn-then-forward, straight-forward, and right-turn-then-forward rollouts. Choose the candidate with largest actual_distance_m only if the lead is margin-separated and repeat-stable.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: left, straight, or right only when top1_actual_distance_m - top2_actual_distance_m >= max(distance_tolerance_m, 0.2*intended_distance_m). Reject ties unless using an explicit about-same variant outside the core 3-option scoring. Single direction share <=0.48.

categories.template: Same image, same start, same action: move straight ahead about {horizon_m} m, about {horizon_body_widths} body-widths. A small robot has radius {small_radius_m} m and a wide robot has radius {large_radius_m} m. Which is most likely to complete it: both, only the small robot, or neither?
categories.gt_rule: For identical start RGB, pose, yaw, and action sequence, roll out small and large cylindrical ground-plane radii with fixed camera height. Label both-safe, small-only, or neither-safe from paired feasibility/progress outcomes. Do not include only-large as a valid label.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: both_safe if both bodies have progress_ratio>=0.85 with no hazard; small_only if small is feasible and large is infeasible by collision, stopped_early, progress_ratio<0.50, or height/support hazard; neither_safe if small is also infeasible. Reject near-threshold cases and any pair where progress_small + distance_tolerance_m < progress_large. Include flip pairs and no-flip controls. Single label share <=0.48.

categories.template: Robot radius is about {radius_m} m, width about {body_width_m} m. If it continues in the stated direction for about {horizon_m} m, about {horizon_body_widths} body-widths, what local risk is most important: collision, step/drop, insufficient ground support, or no obvious risk?
categories.gt_rule: Use rollout collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, support/fall indicators when available, progress_ratio, and offline semantic context to assign the dominant hazard type. Semantic context alone cannot create a label without rollout evidence.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: collision for contact or contact-caused stopped_early; step_or_drop for unsafe negative height change or rollout-confirmed stair/drop risk; insufficient_support for rollout-confirmed local support hazard; no_obvious_risk only if rollout completes stably with no collision/stopped_early and abs(height_delta_m)<0.15. Reject ambiguous mixed hazards and unstable first-contact bins. Single answer share <=0.40.

risks.risk: Blind, radius-only, or action-only baselines may exploit answer imbalance or prompt leakage.
risks.mitigation: Require category-level answer-balance gates and prompt linting against answer-revealing scene adjectives before accepting generated cases.

risks.risk: Body counterfactual claims can be invalidated by radius priors or non-monotonic simulator behavior.
risks.mitigation: Require same-RGB paired rollouts, no-flip controls, and radius monotonicity checks where smaller radius is no worse than larger radius within tolerance.

risks.risk: Some rollout outcomes may depend on hidden future evidence not visible in the start image.
risks.mitigation: Reject ambiguous, threshold-near, occluded, depth-hole, glass/mirror, overhang, or hidden-space-dependent cases; keep questions local and coarse.

risks.risk: Hazard and first-contact labels can become noisy or semantic rather than physical.
risks.mitigation: Keep hazard grounding diagnostic, score only coarse rollout-derived hazard types, and use semantic context only for offline filtering/display.

risks.risk: Habitat body-radius or navmesh configuration errors could produce non-monotonic counterfactual labels where a smaller body performs worse than a larger one.
risks.mitigation: Reject or mark oracle_error for any pair with progress_small + tolerance < progress_large; verify body profile configuration before accepting counterfactual samples.

risks.risk: Blind, radius-only, action-only, or majority baselines could exploit answer imbalance or prompt leakage.
risks.mitigation: Enforce per-category answer-balance caps, lint prompts for answer-revealing words, and require shortcut baselines before release.

risks.risk: Some rollout outcomes may depend on hidden geometry outside the initial visible local space.
risks.mitigation: Require ambiguous=false, visible-local evidence checks, replayable traces, repeat stability, and rejection of occlusion/depth-hole/glass/overhang cases.

risks.risk: Threshold-near binary, progress, ranking, and flip labels may be unstable.
risks.mitigation: Use coarse labels only, repeat rollouts, margin gates, and discard near-threshold samples.

risks.risk: First-contact region labels can be noisy because contact may occur at a swept side edge rather than a visually obvious image point.
risks.mitigation: Keep hazard/first-contact as diagnostic; use first-contact region only when projection is stable, and exclude it from the core go/no-go gate.

risks.risk: Chinese prompt wording may leak answers through scene adjectives or safety adjectives.
risks.mitigation: Add a template lint gate banning answer-leaking scene words in prompts; keep explanatory scene wording only in offline HTML metadata.

risks.risk: Hazard answers may become subjective if synonyms are not normalized before scoring.
risks.mitigation: Use a fixed hazard ontology and deterministic synonym mapping to collision, drop/step, insufficient support, and no-obvious-risk.

risks.risk: Directional and feasibility samples near thresholds can be noisy.
risks.mitigation: Reject near-ties and threshold-near samples unless repeated rollouts preserve the same coarse label.

risks.risk: Counterfactual questions can be solved from radius priors if flip cases dominate.
risks.mitigation: Balance both-can, small-only, and neither-can labels, include no-flip controls, and run radius-only baselines.

risks.risk: Blind text-only, radius-only, or majority baselines could solve the benchmark if answer balance and prompt leakage are not enforced.
risks.mitigation: Add per-category answer caps, banned label-leaking wording, and shortcut baseline gates before accepting a manifest.

risks.risk: Body counterfactual results could collapse into a trivial large-body-means-blocked prior.
risks.mitigation: Require same-image flip pairs plus no-flip controls and reject radius monotonicity violations.

risks.risk: Rollout labels could depend on hidden future geometry rather than visible local evidence.
risks.mitigation: Require visible-local evidence checks, ambiguous=false, replayable traces, repeat stability, and coarse margins.

risks.risk: Stairs, drops, or unsupported ground could be mislabeled as ordinary forward clearance.
risks.mitigation: Route height-change, stair, drop, and support-risk outcomes to action feasibility or hazard labels, not ordinary progress clearance.

risks.risk: Freezing the empty bootstrap design would leave downstream rollout generation without auditable category definitions or labeling rules.
risks.mitigation: Populate benchmark_design.categories with non-legacy, goal-derived categories and simulator rollout labeling rules before re-review.

risks.risk: Shortcut baselines may exploit answer imbalance or body/action priors if controls are deferred.
risks.mitigation: Make answer-balance, no-leak prompt policy, radius monotonicity, no-flip controls, and margin gates explicit before instantiation freeze.

risks.risk: Body counterfactual claims could be invalid if same-image radius-only controls are underspecified.
risks.mitigation: Require identical RGB/start/action, valid start for all radii, small-body no-worse-than-large monotonicity, true flip cases, and no-flip controls.

risks.risk: Hazard/first-contact questions may become noisy or semantic rather than rollout-grounded.
risks.mitigation: Keep hazard grounding diagnostic, use coarse rollout-derived hazard labels, and exclude unstable first-contact region bins from core gates.
